# What the security gates must have read (.github/workflows/security-gates.yml).
#
# The whole guide is held to the gates: a chapter that fails any of them fails
# the job, and that needs no entry here. This file does a different job. Each
# line names a chapter, a Part or an example tree, and the job fails if no gate
# report mentions it. A Part that was renamed, or whose manifests stopped being
# extracted, would otherwise drop out of the gates without a failure anywhere.
#
# Every Part from 00 to 15 is listed, with the example trees. The appendix is
# not, because it holds no manifest and no report would ever mention it. A
# failure in the appendix still fails the job. Parts 16 and 17 are outlines
# whose labs wait; .github/security-gates-report-only.txt names them.
#
# One path per line, relative to full-guide/. A directory covers everything
# under it, example trees included. Remove a line only if the chapter is
# deleted or renamed.

00-foundations/
01-core-workloads/01-pods.md

05-security/02-pod-security.md
